input.title: Field sizes, defaults and record-number settings
input.answer: Keep the characteristics of each analogous OOTB field when copying it, including unset text lengths. Use AutoNumber for RecordNo. SourceEntryID starts blank (NULL). Keep monthly summary dimension and Date editable only when the summary is created. Set the actual corresponding relationship-ID names during configuration.
input.remaining: No further information is required for IN-02. IMP-07 sets the native ID-key names while configuring the handler. The existing requirement to supply SourceEntryID before first save is retained; NULL is its starting value, not a generated identifier.
